name: com.delagged/delagged
title: Delagged
description: Jet lag plans for any flight: when to sleep, seek light and eat. Free, no account.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Builds a day-by-day jet lag plan for a trip: when to sleep, when to seek and avoid bright light, caffeine cutoffs, meal timing, melatonin where the traveler uses it, from the days before departure through the week after landing. Give the flights with local times at each airport; connections are separate flights. Returns an honest expectation (direction, shift, how many days the plan targets, what unaided adjustment typically takes) and the plan. Use whenever someone asks how to handle jet lag for a specific flight or trip, what to do on the plane, or when to sleep after landing.

from.description: Departure airport: IATA code (GVA) or city (Geneva)

to.description: Arrival airport: IATA code (MEX) or city (Mexico City)

departure.description: Local departure date and time at the departure airport, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm

arrival.description: Local arrival date and time at the arrival airport, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm

flights.description: The flights in order. Connections are separate entries.

effort.description: How much the traveler will do. full: up to 3 days of preparation before the flight and the strictest windows. real_life (default): at most one day before, nothing that fights normal work and social hours. arrival_only: nothing before landing.

usual_wake.description: Habitual wake time at home, HH:mm (default 07:00)

chronotype.description: Morning person, neither, or night owl

uses_melatonin.description: Whether the traveler already uses melatonin. If omitted, follows the home market's default (not sold over the counter in Japan, for example). Delagged times it; it never tells anyone to start.

home_locale.description: BCP-47 locale of the traveler's home, e.g. en-CH, ja-JP, en-US; sets the melatonin default

tools.name: compare_flights
tools.description: Compares two to four candidate itineraries for the same trip by running the Delagged plan engine on each: how many days after landing each plan needs, and what the arrival puts the traveler in front of (morning light, an evening, a night). Use before booking, when someone is choosing between flight times or routings and asks which is better for jet lag. Flight time is a tiebreaker after price and connections; the scores are model outputs from light-timing principles, not measured outcomes.

label.description: How the user refers to this option, e.g. 'the morning flight' or 'option B'

tools.name: explain_jet_lag
tools.description: Explains the jet lag for a route without flight times: direction (eastward or westward), size of the shift, roughly how long unaided adjustment takes, and why one direction is harder, with links to Delagged's guides. Use for general questions ('how bad is jet lag from London to Tokyo?'). For an actual itinerary use plan_trip.
